name: Solar Inverter Charger
benefit: - **For 320-watt Solar Inverter Charger System:** A subsidy of ₹6,000/- is provided. - **For 640-watt Solar Inverter Charger System:** A subsidy of ₹10,000/- is provided.
_eligibility_text: 1. Any resident family of Haryana with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP) to apply. 1. All the households who have domestic inverter and not installed solar inverter charger on his/her existing inverter. 1. Applicants who have not installed Solar Inverter Charger in past 5 years under the Department Scheme.
